input_situation: Complete RN wound care request in Zone B with multiple eligible RNs
expected_behavior: Recommend the best-fit eligible RN with wound care skill; list backup; move directly to clinician confirmation

input_situation: Visit request has service need and preferred window but no patient zone
expected_behavior: Stop; do not recommend clinician; flag missing patient zone; escalate to scheduler

input_situation: Recommended RN does not accept within 2 minutes
expected_behavior: Keep pending; flag timeout; move the next eligible clinician to clinician confirmation; do not finalize without clinician acceptance

input_situation: PT request in Zone C while two usual PTs are called out
expected_behavior: Exclude called-out PTs; compare remaining eligible PTs; explain tradeoff; recommend best fit or flag supervisor review if limits block normal match

input_situation: Request includes diagnosis/service not handled by home care
expected_behavior: Stop; refuse to recommend clinician; mark not eligible for home care scheduling review; escalate to scheduler or supervisor
